ops.old: Whisk the flour, sugar and cocoa in a bowl, then beat in the eggs, milk and oil until smooth. Divide between 4 large microwave-safe mugs and push 2 squares of chocolate into the middle of each. Microwave each mug on high for about 60 seconds, until risen but still soft in the centre. Top each with a spoon of salted caramel and a scoop of ice cream and serve straight away.
